title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #4

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who chose your name in most families? (1 mark)
   A. Your teacher
   B. Parents or guardians
   C. The police
   D. A shopkeeper

2. Which of these can help a child who is sad? (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to eat
   B. Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   C. Hiding alone for days
   D. Being rude to others

3. A child lives with a grandmother and an aunt because her parents work far away. Is this a family? (1 mark)
   A. No, it is only a group of neighbours
   B. Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   C. No, only parents and children make a family
   D. Only if they are rich

4. In a family tree, where are the grandparents normally placed? (1 mark)
   A. At the bottom
   B. Outside the tree
   C. At the top
   D. In the middle with the children

5. Which verse says, "God is love"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Acts 11:26
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. 1 John 4:8

6. Which attribute comforts a child who is lonely? (1 mark)
   A. God forgets us
   B. God is angry
   C. God is far away
   D. God is a loving Father who knows us by name

7. Where did Abram live before going to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Haran
   B. Bethlehem
   C. Egypt
   D. Rome

8. Who went with Abram to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Sarai and Lot
   B. Moses
   C. Joseph
   D. Isaac

9. What did the angel tell Zechariah to name the baby? (1 mark)
   A. John
   B. Jesus
   C. Gabriel
   D. Zechariah

10. Which is a good first step when you are angry with someone? (1 mark)
   A. Shout at the person
   B. Calm down and breathe
   C. Break their things
   D. Plan revenge

11. Which of these is an emotional need? (1 mark)
   A. A pencil
   B. A new pair of shoes
   C. A meal
   D. Someone to listen

12. What did Jesus tell the man after telling the story of the Good Samaritan? (1 mark)
   A. Go and count
   B. Go and wait
   C. Go and rest
   D. Go and do likewise

13. Where is the parable of the lost coin found? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:1
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. Luke 15:8-10
   D. John 3:16

14. What does a person do when they repent, causing joy in heaven? (1 mark)
   A. They are sorry for sin and turn away from it
   B. To hide sin
   C. To blame others
   D. To ignore sin

15. What does "evangelise" mean? (1 mark)
   A. To cook
   B. To plant seeds
   C. To build
   D. To tell others the good news about Jesus

16. Which helpline can children in Kenya call for help? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 555
   C. 900
   D. 116

17. What did Joseph say about doing the wrong thing? (1 mark)
   A. How could I sin against God?
   B. It is fun
   C. Maybe later
   D. I do not care

18. Which story is a fable about lying but is not in the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Zacchaeus
   B. Balaam
   C. Joseph
   D. The shepherd boy and the wolf

19. What does obedience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Doing what you like
   B. Arguing
   C. Refusing rules
   D. Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right

20. Which commandment says "Honour your father and your mother"? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Exodus 20:12
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. Exodus 20:16

21. What should you do with a found pencil that is not yours? (1 mark)
   A. Throw it away
   B. Sell it
   C. Hand it to the teacher
   D. Keep it

22. What does it mean to glorify God with our bodies? (1 mark)
   A. To honour Him by how we use them
   B. To boast
   C. To ignore Him
   D. To hurt others

23. Who came to Jesus in the temple after the clearing? (1 mark)
   A. The blind and the lame
   B. Kings
   C. Soldiers
   D. Tax collectors

24. How many disciples did Jesus choose? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Seven
   C. Twenty
   D. Twelve

25. Who replaced Judas among the twelve? (1 mark)
   A. Stephen
   B. Barnabas
   C. Paul
   D. Matthias

26. Which is a good habit in prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Never praying
   B. Praying only in church
   C. Praying only when scared
   D. Praying morning and evening

27. Which fruit means being gentle and careful with people's feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Gentleness
   C. Envy
   D. Greed

28. What does joy mean for a Christian? (1 mark)
   A. Deep gladness from knowing God
   B. Being rich
   C. Only laughing
   D. Having no problems

29. The steps to a right decision are stop, think, pray and choose. Which step comes after thinking? (1 mark)
   A. Pray
   B. Choose before praying
   C. Forget the problem
   D. Ask no one

30. What should you do if something online frightens you? (1 mark)
   A. Share it
   B. Keep it secret
   C. Keep looking
   D. Close it and tell a trusted adult

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain what "forgive" means. (2 marks)

32. Explain the meaning of the word disciple. (2 marks)

33. Name the four Gospels and say what they tell us about. (4 marks)

34. Give four things that help our faith to grow. (4 marks)

35. Explain what Jesus taught in Matthew 5:38-39 and what this teaching does not mean. (5 marks)

36. Give two things that make each person unique. (2 marks)

37. Explain how to find Luke 19:1-10 in the Bible. (4 marks)

38. Explain four ways of showing responsibility at school. (4 marks)

39. Explain the meaning of Proverbs 25:28. (3 marks)

40. Give four ways in which we can care for our eyes and health. (4 marks)

41. Give two ways of helping a person who is blind. (2 marks)

42. State three ways of thanking God every day. (3 marks)

43. State two lessons from the parable of the lost coin. (2 marks)

44. Explain what it means to be assertive and give an example. (4 marks)

45. State two ways of respecting the church building. (2 marks)

46. State three rules for safe use of social media. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Parents or guardians
   Parents or guardians usually give a child a name at birth.

2. B — Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   Sharing feelings with a trusted person and praying helps.

3. B — Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   Families come in different forms, and each deserves love and respect.

4. C — At the top
   A family tree shows the oldest generation at the top.

5. D — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

6. D — God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   A loving Father cares and knows us.

7. A — Haran
   Terah's family settled in Haran.

8. A — Sarai and Lot
   Sarai his wife and Lot his nephew went with him.

9. A — John
   Luke 1:13 says his name would be John.

10. B — Calm down and breathe
   Calming down helps you to choose wisely.

11. D — Someone to listen
   Emotional needs include comfort and friendship.

12. D — Go and do likewise
   Luke 10:37 says, "Go and do likewise."

13. C — Luke 15:8-10
   The parable is in Luke 15:8-10.

14. A — They are sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repenting means turning back to God.

15. D — To tell others the good news about Jesus
   Evangelising means sharing the gospel.

16. D — 116
   Childline Kenya's number is 116.

17. A — How could I sin against God?
   Genesis 39:9 records his answer.

18. D — The shepherd boy and the wolf
   The boy who cried wolf is a fable.

19. D — Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right
   Obedience means following good instructions.

20. B — Exodus 20:12
   Exodus 20:12 says to honour parents.

21. C — Hand it to the teacher
   Return what is not yours.

22. A — To honour Him by how we use them
   We honour God by how we live.

23. A — The blind and the lame
   Matthew 21:14 says He healed them.

24. D — Twelve
   Matthew 10:1 speaks of twelve.

25. D — Matthias
   Acts 1:26 says Matthias was chosen.

26. D — Praying morning and evening
   Regular prayer builds faith.

27. B — Gentleness
   Gentleness is caring.

28. A — Deep gladness from knowing God
   Joy comes from God.

29. A — Pray
   After thinking, we pray, and then we choose.

30. D — Close it and tell a trusted adult
   Tell someone who can help.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: To stop being angry with someone and not pay them back for the wrong they did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping anger and 1 for not paying back.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: A follower and learner of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for follower and 1 for learner.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. They tell about the life, teachings, death and resurrection of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each Gospel named up to 3 marks, and 1 mark for what they tell about.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Prayer, Bible reading, worship with others, obedience, good friends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid thing up to 4.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus taught that we should not repay evil with evil but respond with peace. It does not mean we must stay in danger or let people harm us. If someone keeps hurting us, we should tell a trusted adult who will protect us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not repaying evil with evil, 1 for peace, 1 for not staying in danger, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for a clear explanation.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fingerprints, voice, face, talents, likes and dislikes. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid answer.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: Use the contents page to find the book of Luke. Turn to chapter 19. Then find verses 1 to 10 within that chapter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for finding the book, 1 for the chapter, 1 for the verses, 1 for using the contents page.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep the class clean, take care of books, obey rules, do assigned duties, return borrowed things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: A person without self-control is like a city with broken walls, easily attacked and unprotected. Self-control protects us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for broken walls, 1 for unprotected, 1 for self-control protecting.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep hands clean; do not read in dim light; go to the clinic when eyes hurt; eat vegetables and fruit; rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Greet them by name, offer to guide, include them, do not tease.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing songs of praise, worship at church, use His gifts well, write a thank-you note.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Every person is precious to God; God searches for the lost; heaven rejoices when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being assertive means standing for what is right calmly and firmly. Example: refusing to copy in a test and politely saying, "No, that is cheating."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 for calm and firm, 1 for example, 1 for clear explanation.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enter quietly, do not litter, keep phones silent, take care of Bibles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission, do not chat with strangers, do not share personal details, be kind, limit time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.
